raw_output: Answer: Sarah's approach to managing personal and work-related stress has evolved over time, particularly in relation to her romantic relationships. Initially, she struggled with vulnerability and stress after a breakdown at work, but through therapy, she learned to set boundaries and be more open about her feelings. This growth allowed her to feel ready to approach her colleague and start a new relationship. As she navigated this new relationship, she prioritized maintaining a professional dynamic at work and sought support from trusted colleagues and her therapist. She also practiced self-care through yoga and reading, recognizing the importance of setting limits for her own well-being.
